source.author: lucan
source.text: Indomitos sciat esse viros, timeatque furentes Et morti faciles animos, et gaudeat hostis Non plures haesisse rates.
source.text_original: Indomitos sciat esse viros, timeatque furentes / Et morti faciles animos, et gaudeat hostis / Non plures haesisse rates.
source.text_english: Let them know that there are men who cannot be tamed; let the enemy fear souls that rage and are ready for death, and let him rejoice that no more ships have run aground.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: haccine nos animae faciles rate nubila contra mittimur?
reuse.text_original: haccine nos animae faciles rate nubila contra / mittimur?
reuse.text_english: Are we then, light-minded souls, sent in this craft against the clouds?
